Related names like Ebenezer ('stone of help') and Eleazar ('God is help') show this theme's importance in Israelite naming. The tragic story attached to this Ezer—killed in a livestock raid gone wrong—shows that even someone named 'help' could die young. His father Ephraim mourned him many days, and the tribe comforted their bereaved ancestor."
